subject: Skyline Bank: BCP artifacts, RTO/RPO numbers and live-witness scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <emartinez@skylinebank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Skyline BCP request — RTO/RPO evidence and witness

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake for the payments platform review, we need the following from Redwood: an indexed set of BCP/DR artifacts (runbooks, failover playbooks, recovery logs), formal RTO and RPO numbers for the hosted inference endpoints we use, and a live-witness session where your on-call or ops team demonstrates failover steps and KV cache warm recovery.

Specifically:
- Confirm RTO and RPO for the API endpoints (peak load and normal load)
- Provide the latest DR runbook and the most recent restoration log for a warm failover test
- Schedule a 60-minute live witness demo (we typically invite SRE and risk) week of May 26–30

Can you confirm what you will share and propose 2x possible time slots for the witness? We prefer EDT afternoons.

Attachments: none on my side (I'll share our SIG template once we start mapping).

Best,
Elena Martinez
Director, Risk & Resilience
Skyline Bank

--
Elena Martinez | Skyline Bank | (612) 555-0147
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <emartinez@skylinebank.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline BCP request — RTO/RPO evidence and witness

Hi Elena,

Thanks — we can absolutely provide the artifacts and run a live witness. Quick clarifying questions so the package is scoped correctly:

1) When you say "hosted inference endpoints" — are you focused on our public Redwood API for your production tenant only, or should we include Dedicated/private configuration guidance as well?
2) For "peak load" RTO/RPO, do you want numbers based on our documented SLOs (95th percentile) or absolute worst-case recovery during a full-region failover testing window?

What we'll plan to deliver (tentative):
- Redwood BCP runbook (DR playbook, escalation ladder, recovery steps)
- RTO/RPO matrix by deployment mode + notes on caching behavior and KV snapshot cadence
- Recent warm-failover log (anonymized) and timestamped KV snapshot metadata
- Witness checklist and step-by-step demonstration plan

Proposed witness slots (EDT):
- Tuesday, May 27 at 14:00 EDT
- Thursday, May 29 at 15:30 EDT

If either works, we'll lock it and share a calendar invite + a Drive folder with artifacts ahead of time. I'll coordinate the internal owners and deliver the package by EOD Wed May 14.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

--

- Hosted Redwood API (normal load): RTO = 15–30 minutes (automated routing + cache warm restart); RPO < 5 minutes (prefix/KV cache checkpoints)
- Hosted Redwood API (peak/region-failure test): RTO = 30–60 minutes (adds model reload and cold-kernel initialization time); RPO < 15 minutes depending on KV snapshot recency
- Dedicated/Private deployments: guidance included (customer-managed infra; typical RTO 30–90 minutes depending on provisioning)

Notes on test artifacts: the warm_cache_snapshot contains only metadata and cache keys; no customer prompts or content. The rto_rpo_matrix includes measured numbers from our May 2025 warm-failover test (anonymized).

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
